events.title: Downtown Puyallup Dolly Day
events.desc: My daughter’s introduction to Dolly Parton was through the incredible Imagination Library, and the books we’ve gotten from it are in regular rotation at bedtime. Friday is Dolly Parton Day, and downtown Puyallup is celebrating with special activities and deals from local businesses. Put on your sparkliest getup to honor the icon herself, then enjoy treats, crafts, a scavenger hunt and more. (Ps…

events.title: Talipapa Market Cultural Festival
events.loc: Filipino Community Center , 5740 Martin Luther King Junior Way S., Seattle
events.desc: Get a head start on celebrating Filipino American History Month at this community festival with plenty of fun activities and special games. Try delicious Filipino food and shop for unique artwork from more than two dozen vendors. Plus, live music and DJs will keep the party going!

events.title: Umbrella Fringe
events.cost: Free; some performances require a ticket
events.desc: Art is everywhere, and it’s taking center stage this weekend in Kirkland. Umbrella Fringe puts a spotlight on art with live music, dance workshops, ballet performances and more. You can even play a competitive game of Rock, Paper, Scissors! On Saturday, head to the Umbrella Fringe Festival at Kirkland Urban for hands-on activities, custom pet drawings and plenty of photo ops.

events.title: Worldwide Day of Play
events.cost: Included with admission ($22.50; ages 24 months and younger are free)
events.loc: Imagine Children’s Museum , 1502 Wall St., Everett
events.desc: Imagine Children’s Museum is one of my family’s favorite spots year-round, but it’s even more fun on Worldwide Day of Play! This year brings a Nickelodeon theme with obstacle courses, a collaborative art project and (you guessed it) slime stations.

events.title: 2026 Washington State Martial Arts Festival
events.desc: My daughter has been asking about martial arts classes, and this festival is the perfect introduction. Families can watch demonstrations, meet local schools and organizations, and learn more about martial arts traditions.

events.title: Sustainable Ballard Festival
events.loc: Loyal Heights Community Center , 2101 N.W. 77th St., Seattle
events.desc: Apple cider pressing, cornhole and hula hooping, oh my! You can expect all of that and more at this free festival. Sustainability is at the heart of it, with stewardship workshops, games and community-building activities that will inspire the whole family. Bring plants and puzzles for the community swap!

events.title: Opera Center Open House
events.loc: Seattle Opera Center , 363 Mercer St., Seattle
events.desc: I am so curious about the Seattle Opera, and this is an incredible peek behind the scenes! Take a tour of the costume shop, props department and broadcasting studios. You can even try on costumes. There will also be opera performances, kid-friendly crafts and more activities to enjoy.

events.title: Fright Fest at Wild Waves
events.cost: $41.99–$69.99; discounts available online (free with season pass)
events.loc: Wild Waves Theme Park , 36201 Enchanted Pkwy. S., Federal Way
events.desc: It’s the final Fright Fest before Wild Waves closes for good . Families can get a head start on the season’s festivities because Booville is opening early! Head to the theme park for trick-or-treating, face painting and more entertainment geared toward the 12 and younger crowd. (If you’re looking for more scares, Fright by Night starts Oct. 2.)

events.title: The Italian Festival
events.loc: Seattle Center A rmory , 305 Harrison St., Seattle
events.desc: Ready to toss a pizza in the air? Kids can do that and more at this lively fest! Decorate Venetian masks, get your face painted and cheer on teams in the bocce tournament. There will also be an art exhibit, an Italian marketplace, live music and grape stomping. Don’t miss Saturday’s Italian car show by the International Fountain.

events.title: Pickle at the Palms Grand Opening – Family Play Day
events.loc: Pickle at the Palms , 3435 15th Ave. W., Seattle
events.desc: Ready to check out a new indoor pickleball facility? Head to Pickle at the Palms for a grand opening celebration and a full day of family play. You can expect junior-focused clinics for age 5 and older, plus open play sessions. Fuel all that playtime with a smoothie or soft serve ice cream from the on-site café.
